comment.body: Thanks for describing the yellow, orange, and blue connection loop between the Windows 10 and Windows 11 PCs. Related #51077 does not prove this pair is fixed. Please confirm whether both machines still reproduce it on latest stable; if they do, add a `/bugreport` from each PC immediately after one failed attempt and identify each endpoint Windows build and PowerToys version. This can separate a peer handshake problem from a single-endpoint failure.
